extracted.name: Tabbouleh
extracted.description: Tabbouleh (also spelled tabouli or tabouleh) is a Middle Eastern salad made from fresh herbs and bulgur wheat. We love this version for picnics and mezze platters. Make it up to 3 days in advance, and serve it chilled or at room temperature.
ingredient_lines: 3 cups finely chopped curly parsley (about 2 bunches)
⅓ cup finely chopped fresh mint
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, coriander, and cinnamon. Add the parsley, cucumber, tomato, bulgur, mint, and scallions and toss to combine.
Season to taste and chill until ready to serve.
